::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/{key}"}
#docs
Always 200 for a known push integration; `status` is `not_connected` until connected.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `key` | `string` | **yes** | The key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The integration connection's id. |
| `integration` | `string` | The integration connection's integration. |
| `business` | `string` | The integration connection's business. |
| `status` | `string` | The integration connection's status. One of `not_connected`, `active`, `disabled`. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | Whether the integration connection is enabled. |
| `livemode` | `string` | The integration connection's livemode. One of `test`, `live`. |
| `config` | `object` | The integration connection's config. |
| `connected_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The connected time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the integration connection was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `stats` | `object` | The integration connection's stats. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such integration |
